text:
Parent’s invitation
Edit : my husband was not able to go yesterday to MH in Yafo (he stayed with me at the hospital) - he messaged them to let them know and asked for a new meeting. Is there anything we should do ? Should we go there one morning or wait for their response on our email ? They’re coming on August 20th. 

Hi! Tomorrow we have an appointment at MH in Yafo to invite my French parents to come visit us for 2.5 weeks in August. 

I’m currently 9 months pregnant and tomorrow morning, we will need to go to Ichilov for an appointment before the appointment at Yafo. I have no idea how long it will take in Ichilov … 

My husband (the Israeli) is coming with me to the hospital and messaged Yafo to ask to delay the appointment by a few hours. We’re not sure if this will work as we’re getting closer to August 20th (date of arrival of my parents). 

If he goes by himself to the appointment in MH to invite my parents, would this be ok or do I need to be there ? If we do a video a call while he’s there and I’m in the hospital would that work ? 

Any experience sharing with this process is welcomed 🙂 

Thanks, 

Pauline
